author: /root
scope: Known-case replay only. The labels, graphs and expected values were disclosed before encoding. No held-out detection, novelty, general accuracy or implementation superiority is claimed.

cases.domain: Finite simple undirected graph; all present conductances are positive rational numbers. Disconnected graphs are permitted by the original indexed identity.
cases.laplacian: L_ii=sum_j w_ij; L_ij=-w_ij for i!=j, with zero for absent edges
cases.source_expression: Product of all eigenvalues with multiplicity after deleting exactly one designated zero, divided by n
cases.summary_expression: Product of only the nonzero eigenvalues with multiplicity, divided by n
cases.tree_total: Zero: there are two connected components and only two edges for four vertices. No spanning tree exists.
cases.within_instance_source_control: Source expression equals the zero spanning-tree total and each of the four principal cofactors

cases.locator: PDF page 5: weighted tau; page 12: tau_e; page 15: Corollary 4.7
cases.domain: Connected loop-free undirected triangle with positive rational conductances; distinct in-range terminals 0 and 1
cases.tau: Sum of the three products of conductances over spanning trees
cases.tau_e: Same weighted sum restricted to trees containing edge index 0
cases.ordinary_counts: Three spanning trees; two contain edge index 0
cases.current: Inject +1 at vertex0; extract -1 at vertex1; zero at vertex2

negations.summary_query: node equations and guards and R_eff != 2/(3*2)
negations.source_control_query: same node equations and guards and R_eff != 4/(5*2)

independence: Z3 solves the triangle constraints; SymPy replays exact matrices and model values. Independent semantic review and direct certificate checking remain required; shared packages are not independent implementations.
